candidate.claim: defu is cast to DefuInstance which requires fn/arrayFn/extend but the implementation never assigns them, so defu.fn, defu.arrayFn and defu.extend are undefined at runtime.
candidate.title: defu instance missing fn/arrayFn/extend implementations

verifier.reason: Confirmed: defu.ts:52 casts the bare function returned by createDefu at defu.ts:45-49 to DefuInstance without assigning fn/arrayFn/extend required at types.ts:54-56, and defuFn/defuArrayFn at defu.ts:56 and defu.ts:64 are separate exports never attached to defu.
